D019-D005_h001.question: "I haven't been sleeping right for months now, doc. I'll drift off, but then I'm wide awake a few hours later, just staring at the ceiling. I’ve also been seeing things too, shadows moving in my peripheral vision, quick flashes that aren’t there when I look directly.
